what: A STRUCTURAL census of every entity-block layout document stored in production: the row skeleton, the block TYPE in each cell, and the FIELD NAMES of each authored content/style bag. Shape only — no tenant copy, no field values, no ids, no slugs. Same discipline as scripts/stored-block-types.json, and for the same reason.
why: E0 (docs/EDITOR-E0.md §1) re-keys these documents from block id to node id. §1.5 step 2 requires upgradeLayout to be proven "against all 41 real production documents in a frozen fixture" — this is that fixture, for the 37 of them that are EntityLayout. It is also the only place the BENCH is visible: 34 authored content bags in 18 of 18 Space documents belong to blocks that no cell references, and a fold that only walks `cells` deletes every one (ADR-1129).
scope: The ENTITY-BLOCK catalog only (lib/entity-blocks/registry.ts) and its four EntityLayout stores. The Puck-shaped registry (lib/page-editor/config.tsx) and its `pages` documents are covered by scripts/stored-block-types.json; the Spotlight union (lib/spotlight/blocks/schema.ts) is covered by neither and is named in LIVE-119.
howToRecapture: Run recaptureQuery (read-only) per store against production, rewrite `documents`, and set capturedAt. Recapture after a document migration; the guard reads the registry live, so a REGISTRY change never needs one.

profiles.meta.entityGrid.note: Zero stored member grids, measured 2026-08-25 and on 2026-08-10 before that. Listed so a future non-zero reading is visible as a change rather than a gap.

nurture_steps.block_json.note: Zero stored documents. Same reason as above.

recaptureQuery:
-- per store; `n` replaces the slug/id so nothing tenant-identifying is frozen.
with s as (select preferences->'profileLayout' as doc, row_number() over (order by slug) as n from public.spaces where preferences ? 'profileLayout')
select s.n,
  (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object('id',r->>'id','columns',(r->>'columns')::int,'ratio',r->>'ratio','title',case when r ? 'title' then 'x' end,'headerOn',r->'headerOn','mt',r->>'mt','mb',r->>'mb','cells',r->'cells')) order by ord) from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(s.doc->'rows','[]'::jsonb)) with ordinality e(r,ord)) as rows,
  (select string_agg(k||'['||coalesce((select string_agg(ik,'+' order by ik) from jsonb_object_keys(s.doc->'content'->k) ik),'')||']', ',' order by k) from jsonb_object_keys(coalesce(s.doc->'content','{}'::jsonb)) k) as content,
  (select string_agg(k||'['||coalesce((select string_agg(ik,'+' order by ik) from jsonb_object_keys(s.doc->'style'->k) ik),'')||']', ',' order by k) from jsonb_object_keys(coalesce(s.doc->'style','{}'::jsonb)) k) as style,
  coalesce(s.doc->'hidden','[]'::jsonb) as hidden
from s;
note: A row's `title` is recorded as the literal 'x' — its PRESENCE is structural (it changes `rowShowsHeader`), its text is tenant copy.
